video.topic: Claude made it easier to manage AI agents with four new features, including their own session budget and choosing where the agent runs, US or Europe.

transcript.text: Claude just made it easier to run their managed AI agents with these four new features. Number one, each managed agent can now have its own session budget, meaning no more overspending in things that you don't need. Number two, each session can get their own advisor, meaning a bigger, more intelligent model that is going to help them while they're working. Number three, they can now load their skills from any repository that you connect them to. And number four, now you can choose where the inference is running, meaning that you can choose where your AI agent is going to be working from, whether it's the US or Europe. Now, follow for more AI news, videos, and tutorials each and every single day, and catch you in the next one.
